description: Read one product in full: description, ingredients, usage, images, every variant with price and stock, delivery estimate and return policy. product accepts a product ID, product slug, variant slug or SKU.

guest_token.description: Optional. Your guest_token from create_cart, if you have one, so this lookup belongs to your shopping session. Not needed to search or read products.

product.description: A product ID, product slug, variant slug or SKU, e.g. from search_products.

name: get_product
